README.md.unique_knowledge: States the discipline that the field manual is plain static files, that cnahead records the exact CNA revision documented, and that generators read Git objects directly and never change the CNA branch or working tree. The Git-objects / no-checkout discipline and the exact-revision marker carry over to libcna's generators and pin policy; the Developer site's own make targets do not.

cnahead.unique_knowledge: Developer's cnahead names d6e9ff050e32bcfe5e7fd640006619a90b92298c, an ancestor of TARGET 009d40f5dd08 (55 commits earlier; 224 files changed, concentrated in OpenGL4, SDL_gpu, EasyGL, graphics tests/examples and cmake/). libcna's own cnahead (TARGET) is authoritative; the Developer pin and the delta are recorded in this ledger and drove the mandatory re-verification list.

.gitignore.unique_knowledge: Editor and Python-cache ignore patterns only; no documentation knowledge.

Makefile.unique_knowledge: make generate / check / serve: regenerate references and search data, run link and source-link checks, preview locally. Replaced by scripts/generate_dev_reference.py, scripts/build_site_indexes.py and scripts/validate_all.sh, which the Maintenance page documents.

scripts/generate_reference.py.unique_knowledge: The derivation rules of the four generated inventories (module shape counts; option()/set(... CACHE ...) scan; add_executable/add_test scan filtered to test-related names; 'public header' = under include/CNA or include/Microsoft outside Internal), reading CNA only through git ls-tree/git show. Ported (with cmake_dependent_option support, renderer-family table and a fifth selection-axes inventory) and rendered in libcna chrome.

scripts/generate_search.py.unique_knowledge: Builds a client-side full-text index for the Developer site. libcna keeps a single search: scripts/build_site_indexes.py now also indexes every Development page (title, description, per-page keywords), so no second search system exists.

scripts/check_site.py.unique_knowledge: Static link/fragment checks plus verification that every source link is pinned to the recorded commit and the path exists in that Git tree. Ported as scripts/check_source_links.py (pinned-to-TARGET and path-exists rules for development/**; binding-repository pins) alongside scripts/validate_site.py. The Node/framework-artifact ban is specific to the Developer site and not carried over.

assets/site.js.unique_knowledge: Developer's client-rendered navigation model (groups: Human Takeover, Architecture, Source tours, Making changes, Testing & debugging, Module/Graphics/Platform/Content/Input/Audio/Interop/Build internals, Reference) and revision constant. The grouping survives as the manifest-driven Development sidebar; navigation is server-generated static HTML, working without JavaScript.

assets/site.css.unique_knowledge: Presentation only. libcna's shared stylesheet, extended additively for the Development area (local nav, source links, evidence box, related-pages block, pager), replaces it.

assets/search-index.js.unique_knowledge: Generated data file. Replaced by libcna's single search-index.json, which lists every Development page.

docs/COVERAGE.md.unique_knowledge: Developer's own audit ledger: per-module, per-renderer-family, per-platform and per-binding review state with remaining-work lists, the human-takeover spine status, the meaning of its state vocabulary, and the completion gate for a deep page (purpose, types, ownership, runtime path, threading, failures, destruction, invariants, tests, realistic changes, reading order). Absorbed as: the honest 'covered in depth / not covered' section of the Development home and the generated module index (whose 'maintainer page' columns are the mechanical form of the ledger); the completion gate as 'How an internals page is organised' on the Internals hub; the reserved SDL12/EMSCRIPTEN note and the binding ABI pins on the pages that own them. Its states describe Developer's documentation audit, never CNA product status, and none is republished.
